Your job: work out which symbol is on which key (note: the backslash symbol is written "\\" inside JSON strings).

EACH TURN

- Next turn you are told which 5 symbols those keys held, as a list sorted in the same fixed order as the symbol list above. You are NOT told which symbol came from which key. Overlap your chords cleverly to pin symbols to keys.

Next turn you are told exactly WHICH keys were rotated, but not how they were rearranged. Rotations continue for the ENTIRE game and never stop: there is no rotation-free endgame.

LOCKS (optional, side score)
On any press turn you may lock letters onto keys you are sure of: +1 point if correct at that moment, -3 if wrong. You get no feedback on locks during the game. Each key can be locked only once, ever.

FINAL GUESS
You may end the game at any time by submitting your full guess. After turn 36 you MUST submit it. Your main score is how many of the 47 keys you guess correctly, judged against the arrangement at the moment you guess.

RESPONSE FORMAT
Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no other text.
To press: {"presses": ["L-pinky-num-out", "L-pinky-bottom", "L-ring-bottom"]}
To press and lock: {"presses": [ ... 5 addresses ... ], "locks": {"L-pinky-num": "`"}}
